name: 3D Student's t Distribution Splatting
aliases: Student's t distribution mixture model with negative components
definition: A volume rendering method using 3D Student's t distributions as mixture components instead of Gaussians, utilizing a principled sampler (SGHMC) and positive/negative components to improve parameter efficiency.
summary: 3D Student's t Distribution Splatting replaces Gaussian primitives with flexible distributions and negative scooping components to improve expressivity and reduce component counts.
